subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept the fourteen new immutable third-party Action revisions in credentialed CI, release, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: The branch changes code executed by GitHub Actions with private keys, tokens, release credentials, and automation privileges; accepting that upstream trust boundary requires repository-owner intent rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Verify and accept the pinned revisions
options.body: Confirm the new SHAs against the official upstream releases and merge after accepting their behavior in credentialed workflows.

options.title: Split or defer sensitive upgrades
options.body: Keep only independently approved low-risk action updates and defer token-bearing, release, or Codex-agent revisions for separate review.

options.title: Close and regenerate later
options.body: Close this Dependabot batch if the repository prefers a freshly generated update after its workflow-action review policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Verify and accept the pinned revisions
recommendation.body: Confirm the new SHAs against the official upstream releases and merge after accepting their behavior in credentialed workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: A repository-level owner is the best available routing candidate for accepting changes to security-labeled credentialed workflows.
